name: 10-Trace Resistive Depth Probe
description: Like a water dipstick! Ten parallel copper traces detect liquid immersion depth by electrical resistance.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a water dipstick! Ten parallel copper traces detect liquid immersion depth by electrical resistance.
wiringGuidance: Connect + (Red) to 5V, - (Dark Slate) to GND, and S (Yellow) to analog pin A0.
commonMistakes: Submerging past the maximum level line and wetting the top wire pins.
Powering constantly in water, accelerating copper electrolysis corrosion.

miniExperiment.title: Water Immersion Gauge
miniExperiment.circuit: + to 5V, - to GND, S to Analog Pin A0.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Reads 0 when dry; dipping into water increases value proportionally up to ~650.
